Check how these apps fit together, with these company rules, which apply across the apps named:

response.text: {"items":[{"text":"Customer contracts has no step where Lena approves a contract over $10,000, and Lena can't even see the contracts because only Wade, Krishna and each contract's owner can. The company rule says contracts over $10,000 need her approval, so they can move forward without it.","capabilities":["Customer contracts"]}]}
